notes.title: Patch [v1.1.2]
notes.notes: Added a new achievement and made That Heavy!? possible to achieve

notes.title: Minor patch [v1.1.1]
notes.notes: Patched a bug allowing the Rewind achievement to be earned without clicking the Play Again button.

notes.title: The Achievement Update [v1.1]
notes.notes:
May your nuts be heavy and your days be full. Here's a list of changes this update has brought:

Added:
 + 10 new achievements
 + 2 new hidden achievements
 + 1 easter egg
 + "Replay" and "Quit" buttons on the Win screen

Removed:
- Automatic game close upon winning

notes.title: April Fools'!
notes.notes:
So, how heavy are [i]your[/i] nuts? 
I've noticed many new sales today - How many of you are here because of a gift on this fine day?
And to anyone who [i]did[/i] gift this, I appreciate you.

I wish everyone the heaviest of nuts and the longest of shlongs - until next time.
